Hi all, first of all thanks a lot for the efforts put into the app, I love it so far apart from a few things that IMO could be improved.

Specifically colours seems to be a bit of a problem for colour blind persons, just to give you an example I can't distinguish when the up/down voat icon has been clicked.

Probably the simplest solution would be to change the lightness of the icon when un/clicked.

There are many ways you can check colour compliance, but in this case the best solution seems to use any of the online tools to evaluate a snapshot of the application:

http://www.color-blindness.com/coblis-color-blindness-simulator/

There are other links you can use to ensure colour contrast if effectively appropriate (regardless of colour blindness):

http://dasplankton.de/ContrastA/

http://snook.ca/technical/colour_contrast/colour.html

And here a link about accessibility from a wider perspective:

https://24ways.org/2012/colour-accessibility/
